correctness.rationale: The absence-indicator joint formula follows from uniform subsets and a two-stage exact count; the two-pair formula independently follows from an ordered four-individual collision count and the exact polynomial identity (a)_2^2-(a)_4=4(a)_3+2(a)_2. Strict threshold inequalities prove existence of both covariance signs at every N>=4. Exact enumeration independently checks all 60 abundance partitions with 4<=N<=8 for pair counts and 591 general disjoint designs with N<=7; 2595 singleton-doubleton cases confirm the phase law, not replace its proof. For N=4 profiles (2,2) and (3,1), complementarity proves correlations +1 and -1.

value.rationale: The design is naturally the allocation of four distinct sampled individuals to two richness surveys in biodiversity monitoring. Exact sign and phase give the direction of dependence corrections in replicate-survey precision; the minimal N=4 profiles realize extreme +1 and -1 correlations. The explicit all-size singleton/doubleton threshold is natural because these two abundance classes govern rarefaction and collision probabilities. Unlike generic code enumeration, the theorem proves a scale-free sampling boundary for a motivated statistic.
